visualizerParams.title: Code Refactor: map and filter Instead of a Loop with push
visualizerParams.problemDescription: A loop converts each text to a number, tests it and pushes it onto a result array. Use map and filter, with an explicit radix. The output must stay the same.

solution.explanation: The chain reads as the steps of the job (split, convert, keep the valid ones), with no counter or temporary array, and parseInt always gets a radix of 10.
